scope: Named final-run screenshots and sampled video frames inspected; not uninterrupted full-video review or full GitLab acceptance.
observations: Edit form loads the existing bold comment in native Fountain, with Save comment and Cancel controls.
Reply form displays its empty placeholder and disables submission until content is entered; review batching itself is not tested.
Resolved/reopened thread shows edited text, resolved styling and one collapsed reply. Exact reply body and resolved state are verified separately through the real API.
The restart capture visibly retains edited text and resolved styling; a host layout shift crops the lower portion of that card. The reopened capture and sampled video show its reply row.
Sampled video includes the actual MR/wiki editors and readers, native thread creation and resolved reader state.
During the intentional server restart the still-open GitLab page shows polling/network error banners. Graceful reconnect and reader loading remain open, despite later persistence checks passing.
The private integration warning remains visible because inline suggestions and broader product acceptance are unfinished.

frameSheet.sampling: From 80 seconds, one frame per 6 seconds for 60 seconds.
